summary.one_liner: A Rust-built status line for Claude Code that shows kaomoji text-face personas reacting to Claude's activity and error frustration.
summary.what_it_does: Adds a configurable status line to Claude Code with 30+ text-face emoticons that change based on what Claude is doing. The README describes context-aware personas by file type and a frustration system where repeated errors escalate the face toward a table-flip. It also shows the current git branch, working tree status with a file count, the current directory, the active activity (editing, reading, executing, debugging), and the Claude model (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku). Activity is tracked through hooks. An interactive TUI config menu toggles each element, and settings are saved to ~/.claude/personalities_config.json. The README also includes a built-in update check that shows an update notice in the status line.
use_cases: Customize the Claude Code status line with fun emoticons
See at a glance what Claude is currently doing
Show git branch and dirty file count in the terminal prompt area
Track Claude's error frustration during a coding session
Display which Claude model is active in the status line
notable: Kaomoji personas by file type that escalate with mounting errors up to a table-flip face
Single Rust binary with about 1ms statusline rendering and 2-second git status cache
Interactive TUI configuration with pre-selected toggles
Built-in update check shown in the status line
caveats: Windows is not supported; the author says they do not care about Windows development. WSL2 is suggested.
Requires Claude Code v1.0.60 or later and a Nerd Font for icons.
Supported platforms are macOS and Linux only.
